rules.rule: Every run passes the project-config gate before anything else
must: Every\ srd\ skill\ runs\ this\ gate\ first,\ in\ every\ mode,\ before\ reading\ the\ SRD

rules.rule: A failed gate check stops the run; no REST, checkout, or offline fallback
must: Stop\ before\ any\ other\ work\ and\ say\ exactly\ which\ check\ failed
Never\ fall\ back\ to\ a\ REST\ call,\ a\ local\ checkout,\ or\ offline\ work

rules.rule: The SRD standard is fetched live, never a stored copy
must: Never\ use\ a\ stored\ or\ remembered\ copy

rules.rule: Never marks an SRD ACCEPTED; acceptance is human
must: never\ marks\ an\ SRD\ `ACCEPTED`:\ acceptance\ is\ a\ human\ decision
Do\ not\ mark\ the\ draft\ acceptable

rules.rule: No file is written until every Quality-Bar blocker is settled with the user
must: Write\ only\ once\ step\ 4\ has\ settled\ every\ blocker
An\ authoring\ skill\ does\ not\ knowingly\ write\ a\ defect\ it\ has\ already\ named

rules.rule: Interview asks one branch at a time, no bundled questions
must: Ask\ one\ branch\ at\ a\ time
no\ bundled\ questions

rules.rule: A claim about the existing system is searched in the corpus before acceptance; contradictions surfaced
must: `search`\ the\ corpus\ before\ accepting\ it
never\ silently\ accept\ or\ fix

rules.rule: A platform fact reaches srd:kb only after the branch restatement is confirmed, never by a separate prompt
must: reaches\ `srd:kb`\ only\ once\ that\ restatement\ is\ confirmed
never\ through\ a\ separate\ prompt

rules.rule: Doc gaps are captured as drafts and offered at step 5, never filed silently
must: Gaps\ are\ captured\ as\ server\-side\ drafts\ on\ discovery\ and\ offered\ at\ step\ 5
a\ draft\ left\ without\ a\ path\ is\ invisible\ to\ every\ later\ draft\ check

rules.rule: Owners, Initiative, Designs are placeholders; Status is IN PROGRESS
must: Do\ not\ collect\ Owners,\ Initiative\ links,\ or\ Designs\ links
Status\ is\ always\ `IN\ PROGRESS`\ for\ a\ new\ draft

rules.rule: Report counts only, read off the finished file
must: counts\ only
read\ off\ the\ finished\ artifact,\ never\ carried\ from\ the\ work\ that\ produced\ it

rules.rule: KB and SRDs describe the target system and never contradict; a contradiction is a finding no rank settles; a confirmed fact changes the KB at once
must: so\ no\ rank\ settles\ an\ SRD\ claim\ a\ KB\ section\ contradicts
The\ KB\ and\ the\ SRDs\ both\ describe\ the\ target\ system
a\ confirmed\ fact\ changes\ the\ KB\ at\ once

rules.rule: Conflicting corpus sources are settled by the server's rank (lower wins), never by folder name or a remembered order
must: the\ lower\ `rank`\ states\ the\ platform
Never\ settle\ by\ folder\ name,\ source\ type,\ or\ a\ remembered\ order

rules.rule: A stored document reference is the result's id copied as is, never its path; Markdown links stay paths
must: copy\ the\ result's\ `id`\ as\ is,\ never\ its\ `path`
A\ Markdown\ link\ stays\ a\ relative\ path\ built\ from\ `path`

rules.rule: An SRD reference is the SRD's folder name under initiatives, never a document identity
must: SRD's\ folder\ name\ under\ `initiatives`

rules.rule: Reads only id, title, url, aliases; never adds or removes a front-matter key or marker another tool owns
must: Read only the front-matter keys `id`, `title`, `url`, and `aliases`
Never add, remove, or change a front-matter key or marker

rules.rule: No hard-coded trust order or folder name
A user who does not know a platform answer gets exactly one follow-up, "Who would know?"; names make the gap deferred with ask as typed, none make it unknown
must: ask\ exactly\ one\ follow\-up,\ "Who\ would\ know\?"
Names:\ `answer:\ deferred`,\ `ask`\ each\ person's\ name\ exactly\ as\ typed,\ the\ name\ alone
"Nobody",\ "not\ sure",\ or\ no\ name:\ `answer:\ unknown`,\ no\ `ask`
Names\ volunteered\ unprompted\ \("Piotr\ knows"\):\ recorded\ the\ same\ way;\ skip\ the\ question

rules.rule: Corpus-backed text names each source page in a fixed source line; no quote, no caution line, no rank total
must: `Source:\ <title>\ ›\ <heading>\ \(rank\ <n>,\ 1\ =\ most\ trusted\)\ —\ <source_url>`
corpus\ content\ never\ reaches\ SRD\ or\ corpus\-page\ text\ unseen
Never\ a\ quote,\ a\ summary\ of\ the\ page,\ a\ caution\ line,\ or\ a\ rank\ total

rules.rule: A corpus fact reaches the draft only through an interview question with its source line; the report lists every corpus-sourced statement
must: Corpus\ content\ enters\ the\ draft\ only\ through\ the\ interview
lists\ every corpus\-sourced\ statement\ in\ the\ file\ with\ its\ source\ line
